story_note: Friday at the library, Isla encounters a late-week puzzle that feels almost too smooth at first, but a single cell throws her off rhythm and she has to rebuild her confidence quietly.
continuation_note: Unlike Thursday's backtracking struggle, today Isla faces an illusion of ease that collapses suddenly, requiring her to sit with uncertainty and rebuild trust in her own logic rather than strategy.
facebook_post_text: Sometimes the puzzle that looks easiest is the one that catches you. https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk

scenes.title: Back Again
scenes.beat: Isla arrives / opens the grid; calm, returning.
scenes.scene_description: Isla finds a quiet corner table in the library, opening her laptop with the Friday puzzle already loaded. The space around her is hushed, just a few distant whispers and the hum of overhead lights.
scenes.caption: Back again.

scenes.title: Resistance

scenes.scene_description: Then a single cell refuses to resolve, and suddenly nothing else fits. Isla's hands pause above the keyboard, her confidence quietly shaken.
scenes.caption: Not that one.

scenes.scene_description: She leans back slightly, eyes tracing the grid without touching anything. The logic is there, she just has to trust it again.

style_rules: Isla is the only active daily comic character.

Young Black woman, warm medium brown skin, light freckles on nose and cheeks.
Natural coily dark hair in high voluminous puff bun.
Wide floral headband in teal, rust orange, cream, and dusty blue, worn across forehead.
